# Partitions

The commands `mt help` lists under Partitions. Knowledge bases are known as partitions in Maitento, which is why most of these commands start with `partition-`. More in [Knowledge](../../../concepts/knowledge.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`embedding-model-list`](#embedding-model-list) | List the embedding models a knowledge base can be indexed with, and their widths (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-create`](#partition-create) | Create a knowledge base (a partition; tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-delete`](#partition-delete) | Delete an empty knowledge base, by id (delete its files first; tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-embedding-credentials-clear`](#partition-embedding-credentials-clear) | Remove a knowledge base's own embedding keys and its consent to fall back to Maitento's key (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-embedding-credentials-set`](#partition-embedding-credentials-set) | Replace a knowledge base's own embedding keys and fallback consent, from a JSON file on your disk (tenant admins only) *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`partition-embedding-failure-acknowledge`](#partition-embedding-failure-acknowledge) | Mark a knowledge base's embedding key failures as seen (the key stays blocked until replaced; tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-embedding-failure-list`](#partition-embedding-failure-list) | List the knowledge bases whose own embedding keys have failed, one row per failure (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-embedding-probe`](#partition-embedding-probe) | Test an embedding model with your keys and show the width it returns (exits 1 if it fails; tenant admins only) *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`partition-embedding-profile-set`](#partition-embedding-profile-set) | Set the embedding model a knowledge base is indexed with; a change of index needs `--allow-reindex` (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-embedding-stack`](#partition-embedding-stack) | Show the credential stack a knowledge base embeds with, or change it with `--set` or `--clear` (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-embedding-status`](#partition-embedding-status) | Show a knowledge base's embedding model and index state, with any re-index's progress (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-file-list`](#partition-file-list) | List a knowledge base's files, newest first, a page at a time (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-get`](#partition-get) | Show a knowledge base's name, id and creation date, by id (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-list`](#partition-list) | List the tenant's knowledge bases (partitions; tenant admins only) |

## embedding-model-list

List the embedding models a knowledge base can be indexed with, and their widths (tenant admins only).

```text
mt embedding-model-list
```

## partition-create

Create a knowledge base (a partition; tenant admins only).

```text
mt partition-create <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the knowledge base |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--temporary, -t` | flag |  |  | Make it temporary: its files are never indexed and expire |
| `--lifetime-hours <number>` | whole number |  |  | With `--temporary`, how many hours it keeps each file (default: 24) |

## partition-delete

Delete an empty knowledge base, by id (delete its files first; tenant admins only).

```text
mt partition-delete <id>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The knowledge base's id (from partition-list) |

## partition-embedding-credentials-clear

Remove a knowledge base's own embedding keys and its consent to fall back to Maitento's key (tenant admins only).

```text
mt partition-embedding-credentials-clear <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The knowledge base's id (from partition-list) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--confirm` | flag |  |  | Delete it; without this the command only shows what would be deleted |

## partition-embedding-credentials-set

Replace a knowledge base's own embedding keys and fallback consent, from a JSON file on your disk (tenant admins only).

```text
mt partition-embedding-credentials-set <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The knowledge base's id (from partition-list) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--credentials-file, -f <value>` | text | yes |  | JSON file on your disk: an array of {"credentialId", "apiKey", "priority", "provider"?, "baseUrl"?, "modelIdentifier"?} |
| `--allow-fallback` | flag |  |  | Let embedding fall back to Maitento's key when these keys are used up |

**Not available in the cloud shell:** it reads provider API keys from a file on the local disk, and the cloud shell has none.

## partition-embedding-failure-acknowledge

Mark a knowledge base's embedding key failures as seen (the key stays blocked until replaced; tenant admins only).

```text
mt partition-embedding-failure-acknowledge <id>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The knowledge base's id (from partition-embedding-failure-list) |

## partition-embedding-failure-list

List the knowledge bases whose own embedding keys have failed, one row per failure (tenant admins only).

```text
mt partition-embedding-failure-list
```

## partition-embedding-probe

Test an embedding model with your keys and show the width it returns (exits 1 if it fails; tenant admins only).

```text
mt partition-embedding-probe [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--provider <OpenAi\|Gemini\|Qwen>` | one of `OpenAi`, `Gemini`, `Qwen` | yes |  | The provider that serves the model |
| `--model, -m <value>` | text | yes |  | The model's id (from embedding-model-list, unless `--custom`) |
| `--dimensions, -d <number>` | whole number |  |  | Width of the vectors (default: the model's own; required with `--custom`) |
| `--custom` | flag |  |  | The model is not in embedding-model-list (confirm its width with partition-embedding-probe first) |
| `--credentials-file, -f <value>` | text | yes |  | JSON file on your disk: the keys to test with, in the shape partition-embedding-credentials-set takes |

**Not available in the cloud shell:** it reads provider API keys from a file on the local disk, and the cloud shell has none.

## partition-embedding-profile-set

Set the embedding model a knowledge base is indexed with; a change of index needs `--allow-reindex` (tenant admins only).

```text
mt partition-embedding-profile-set <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The knowledge base's id (from partition-list) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--provider <OpenAi\|Gemini\|Qwen>` | one of `OpenAi`, `Gemini`, `Qwen` | yes |  | The provider that serves the model |
| `--model, -m <value>` | text | yes |  | The model's id (from embedding-model-list, unless `--custom`) |
| `--dimensions, -d <number>` | whole number |  |  | Width of the vectors (default: the model's own; required with `--custom`) |
| `--chunk-size <number>` | whole number |  |  | Size of each chunk of text, in tokens (default: the model's) |
| `--chunk-overlap <number>` | whole number |  |  | Tokens each chunk shares with the next (default: the model's) |
| `--custom` | flag |  |  | The model is not in embedding-model-list (confirm its width with partition-embedding-probe first) |
| `--credentials-file, -f <value>` | text |  |  | JSON file on your disk: the knowledge base's own keys, in the shape partition-embedding-credentials-set takes (default: none) |
| `--allow-fallback` | flag |  |  | Let embedding fall back to Maitento's key when the keys are used up |
| `--allow-reindex` | flag |  |  | Allow a change of index: every document is embedded again, and search is refused until that is done |
| `--clear-credentials` | flag |  |  | Without -f, remove the knowledge base's own keys (without this, a knowledge base that has some is refused) |

## partition-embedding-stack

Show the credential stack a knowledge base embeds with, or change it with `--set` or `--clear` (tenant admins only).

```text
mt partition-embedding-stack <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The knowledge base's id (from partition-list) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--set <value>` | text |  |  | Embed with this credential stack, by id or name |
| `--clear` | flag |  |  | Go back to the tenant's default stack or model keys |

```text
mt partition-embedding-status <id>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The knowledge base's id (from partition-list) |

## partition-file-list

List a knowledge base's files, newest first, a page at a time (tenant admins only).

```text
mt partition-file-list <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The knowledge base's id (from partition-list) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit, -l <number>` | whole number |  | `50` | Maximum number of files to list (1-200) |
| `--cursor <value>` | text |  |  | The cursor a previous page printed, for the next page |

List the tenant's knowledge bases (partitions; tenant admins only).

```text

```
